findings: Inspected every full-frame contact sheet and both original/overlay target-crop sheets for these ten actual source frames. The same beige-shirt participant remains localized while reaching for, lifting, holding, turning and replacing the black pan. Head, torso, arms and visible legs remain covered; the pan, round table, tripod and room background remain excluded. No identity switch, broad background takeover, empty target localization or major visible-body omission was observed in the sampled frames. Independently recomputed camera aggregation and consistency checks from the raw per-frame estimates. These are estimated camera intrinsics and sampled mask checks; Body inference has not run.
